title: Engenheiro de software JR
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: UI Web Designer
description:
Queremos um(a) UI Designer especialista em web, com perfil altamente criativo, que domine design system, inglês avançado, e tenha experiência comprovada em projetos de alto destaque visual.

Responsabilidades:

  • Criar interfaces web surpreendentes, inovadoras e ultra-responsivas, com foco em impacto visual e experiência memorável;
  • Propor micro-animações, efeitos interativos, jornadas imersivas e soluções fora do comum, integrando tendências globais do digital;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir design systems modernos, garantindo consistência, flexibilidade e adaptabilidade do produto;
  • Atuar em constante colaboração com desenvolvedores creative front-end, garantindo que ideias ousadas sejam traduzidas para o código;
  • Prototipar experiências avançadas, considerando usabilidade, performance, acessibilidade e web standards;
  • Documentar soluções visuais, componentes e processos para handoff ágil e preciso;
  • Pesquisar referências internacionais, estudando cases premiados e trazendo inovação contínua.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Inglês fluente obrigatório (ambiente internacional, referências globais, reuniões e documentações técnicas);
  • Portfólio robusto, com sites ou produtos digitais de alto impacto visual publicados e ativos;
  • Muita habilidade em prototipação (Figma, Sketch, Framer, Principle, etc.) e handoff para desenvolvimento;
  • Domínio avançado de design system, componentes escaláveis e library thinking;
  • Conhecimento prático de HTML/CSS para entender limitações e propor soluções viáveis (sem necessidade de programação pesada);
  • Forte senso de responsividade, performance web e mobile first;
  • Experiência com animação digital, micro-interações e motion design para web.


Diferenciais:

  • Participação em squads de creative front-end;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de animação para web (Lottie, SVG, GSAP, WebGL);
  • Experiência com Storybook, frameworks de UI criativos, ou processos de entrega de componentes para desenvolvedores;
  • Cases publicados em galerias internacionais.


Buscamos:

  • Criatividade e olhar crítico de quem entende a linguagem do front-end;
  • Capacidade de estudar referências, propor soluções únicas e executar projetos dignos de premiação internacional;
  • Foco em design web de alto nível, escalável e pensado para múltiplos dispositivos;
  • Mente aberta, colaborativa e facilidade de comunicação com desenvolvedores criativos e clientes.


Observações:

  • Não serão considerados apenas protótipos ou conceitos visuais sem publicação real;
  • O processo de seleção irá avaliar não só o visual, mas também a execução técnica, detalhes de responsividade, animações e usabilidade.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Commerce (Hybris)
description:
Desenvolvedor SAP Commerce (Hybris)

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Pleno a Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor SAP Commerce (Hybris) para atuar em projetos de e-commerce B2C e B2B em ambiente SAP Commerce Cloud. O profissional será responsável principalmente pelo desenvolvimento back-end , implementando customizações, integrações e evoluções na plataforma.

Procuramos alguém com 2 a 3 anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento na plataforma, com sólidos conhecimentos em Java e Spring, além de familiaridade com os conceitos de arquitetura e extensibilidade do SAP Commerce.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento back-end do SAP Commerce (Hybris) , criando e mantendo extensões, serviços e integrações.
  • Implementar customizações de lógica de negócio conforme as necessidades do projeto.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos e desenvolvedores front-end, garantindo a coerência das entregas técnicas.
  • Analisar, corrigir e otimizar código visando desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Participar de revisões de código e contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar na integração com outros sistemas corporativos, como SAP ERP ou SAP S/4HANA.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 2 a 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento back-end com SAP Commerce (Hybris) .
  • Domínio de Java, Spring Framework e arquitetura RESTful .
  • Experiência em projetos B2C ou B2B (qualquer um dos dois é suficiente).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência no segmento de telecomunicações (Telco) .
  • Conhecimento em SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) .
  • Familiaridade com SAP CPI e integrações com SAP ERP / S/4HANA.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de automação e pipelines (Jenkins, SonarQube).

title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor Especialista em Arquitetura Corporativa - Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades Principais

  • Conduzir a fase de Discovery/Assessment , mapeando as camadas A a D do TOGAF (Negócios, Sistemas de Informação e Tecnologia).
  • Elaborar e apresentar o modelo AS-IS da arquitetura corporativa e propor o modelo TO-BE compatível com as diretrizes estratégicas do cliente.
  • Estruturar o MVP N0 (alto nível) e o MVP N1 (plano detalhado de execução em Sprints e Deliverables).
  • Traduzir princípios arquiteturais em roteiros de transformação e recomendações de governança.
  • Interagir diretamente com executivos de negócio e TI (CIO, VP de Transformação Digital, Diretor de TI).
  • Produzir apresentações executivas e documentos técnicos com linguagem acessível ao C-Level.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre as camadas de negócio, aplicações e infraestrutura, mantendo a coerência TOGAF.
  • Apoiar a Softtek no desenvolvimento da função de Arquitetura Corporativa contínua dentro no cliente.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Certificação TOGAF 9.2 ou 10 Desejável.
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos em consultoria de arquitetura empresarial ou transformação digital.
  • Histórico comprovado de implementações de arquitetura corporativa em grandes empresas (educação, serviços financeiros, indústria ou varejo).
  • Sólido conhecimento de Business Capability Modeling, Application Mapping, Data Governance, IT4IT e Design Thinking.
  • Vivência com frameworks complementares (ArchiMate, Zachman, LeanIX, Sparx EA ou equivalentes).
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas AS-IS e TO-BE de forma estruturada e documentada.
  • Domínio avançado de PowerPoint, Miro, Lucidchart e Excel para representação visual de modelos.


Detalhes da Contratação

  • Modelo remoto
  • Regime PJ – Alocação temporário 3 meses, podendo prorrogar para até 9 meses.

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / Java / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, Java, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, and Java.
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Role


We’re partnering with a leading global commerce technology organization to expand their Data Engineering & Analytics team. This is an exciting opportunity for senior-level Data Engineers who are passionate about building modern data solutions, optimizing data pipelines, and driving impactful data-driven decisions within a global enterprise environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data management systems, pipelines, and quality assurance frameworks .
  • Establish and enforce data standards, database guidelines, and governance protocols .
  • Develop and implement conceptual and logical database designs , including capacity planning, data loading, and maintenance strategies.
  • Evaluate, install, and optimize database management systems and cloud data platforms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable data models and efficient pipelines .
  • Contribute to data modeling and relational database architecture , ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Support the development of UI prototypes and reporting tools in collaboration with analytics and business stakeholders.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark for data processing and ETL development.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in modern cloud environments.
  • Proven data modeling expertise and familiarity with relational and dimensional models.
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks , Snowflake , or similar.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

title: Sr. Data Asset Management (DAM) Analyst
description:
Job Title: Sr. Data Asset Management (DAM) Analyst

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote


Who We Are Looking For


We are seeking a detail-oriented and data-savvy Data Asset Management (DAM) Analyst to join a dynamic data organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and has a passion for organizing, managing, and optimizing data assets to drive business value.


What You Will Work On

  • Manage and maintain enterprise data assets, ensuring data is cataloged, accessible, and governed according to internal standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data discovery, lineage, and quality initiatives.
  • Utilize SQL to query, validate, and analyze data across various platforms.
  • Support metadata management and data classification efforts.
  • Assist in the implementation and enhancement of data governance tools and processes.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to ensure data assets are aligned with strategic goals.


What You Bring

  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, and transformation.
  • Familiarity with data cataloging tools is a strong plus.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for data integrity and usability.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, or related field.
  • Understanding of data privacy and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

  • Acompanhar a transição para o time de Sucesso do Cliente, garantindo uma implantação fluida e positiva.
  • Compartilhar aprendizados e inteligência de mercado, contribuindo com a evolução da estratégia LATAM.

  • Experiência sólida em vendas Enterprise de SaaS .

  • Vivência comercial em América Latina , com capacidade de adaptação a diferentes culturas e estilos de negociação.
  • Fluência em Espanhol e Inglês avançado/fluente (inglês considerado diferencial).

title: Profissional Full Stack – Angular e .NET com AWS SR
description:
Código da vaga: 54142 / 54638


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com Angular (RxJs, Custom Events, Signal), .NET e arquitetura microsserviços .
  • Conhecimento em Micro Frontends com Web Components e Module Federation.
  • Testes unitários com Jest e automatizados com Cypress.
  • Prática com serviços AWS (S3, CloudFront, Cognito, SQS, ECS).
  • Vivência com bancos de dados NoSQL (DynamoDB), princípios Solid, Clean Code e Clean Architecture .
  • Experiência com versionamento Git e Git-Flow .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com Angular (RxJs, Custom Events, Signal), .NET e arquitetura microsserviços .
  • Conhecimento em Micro Frontends com Web Components e Module Federation.
  • Testes unitários com Jest e automatizados com Cypress.
  • Prática com serviços AWS (S3, CloudFront, Cognito, SQS, ECS).
  • Vivência com bancos de dados NoSQL (DynamoDB), princípios Solid, Clean Code e Clean Architecture .
  • Experiência com versionamento Git e Git-Flow .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About RealQuant

RealQuant is building the first vertical AI platform for commercial real estate — turning OMs, rent rolls, and financials into structured insights that power underwriting, reporting, and portfolio intelligence.

We’re redefining how deals move from OM → LOI in under 30 minutes by combining institutional real estate expertise with modern AI automation.


Role Overview

You’ll own the AI engine behind our document parsers, data feeds, and underwriting agent — training and fine-tuning multimodal models in Azure AI Foundry to deliver sub-10s parsing and automated deal outputs (LOIs, pitch decks, summaries, and recommended assumptions).


Tech Stack

Core AI Platform: Azure AI Foundry (multimodal) · Azure ML (training + fine-tune) · Azure OpenAI


Retrieval & Data: Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid) · pgvector · Databricks (labeling + ETL) · Azure Postgres Flexible · Blob Storage


APIs & Workflows: FastAPI inference services · Azure Durable Functions · Event Grid (ingest triggers) · Service Bus (optional) · API Management (APIM)


Ops & Monitoring: App Insights / Monitor · Key Vault (Managed Identity) · GitHub Actions CI/CD


What You’ll Build

  • Train and fine-tune LLMs + embeddings for OM, Rent Roll, and P&L parsing.
  • Detect and learn document layout patterns to reduce human-in-loop (HITL) review.
  • Build labeled datasets and evaluation benchmarks in Databricks + Azure ML.
  • Integrate 3rd-party market data and create retrieval pipelines via Azure AI Search / pgvector.
  • Develop the AI Underwriting Agent that generates deal summaries, LOIs, pitch decks, and assumptions.
  • Deploy models via Azure ML / Durable Functions with scalable APIs.
  • Optimize inference pipelines for sub-10s end-to-end latency , including preprocessing and write-back to Postgres.
  • Track accuracy, recall, latency & cost with App Insights dashboards; iterate rapidly using Cursor / Claude Code + HITL QA.


Expected Outcomes

  • 3+ production-ready parsers (OM, Rent Roll, or P&L) deployed in Azure
  • 100+ labeled examples + versioned evaluation datasets
  • ≥95% extraction accuracy vs manual baseline
  • AI-generated deal summary & LOI draft live in Excel / web
  • Confidence-scored mappings for Chart of Accounts & unit-type labels with HITL review
  • Parsing pipeline optimized for sub-10s total latency


Experience

  • 5–7 yrs ML engineering (modeling, evaluation, MLOps)
  • 3+ yrs LLM / Document AI (fine-tuning, embeddings, RAG)
  • Hands-on with Azure AI Foundry / Azure ML / OpenAI API
  • Python + PyTorch / Transformers expertise
  • Experience with pgvector or AI Search for retrieval
  • FinTech, PropTech, or Data SaaS background a plus
  • Fluent English · ownership mindset · outcome-driven


Selection Process

  • 90-minute async coding / model task
  • Technical interview
  • Paid trial sprint (build a real parser module)


Compensation & Setup

Independent Contractor | Hourly DOE

Full-time remote · EST overlap · Immediate start

Long-term contract with growth potential


How to Apply

  • Send your GitHub, demo, or portfolio of embedding / LLM work, plus a short note on a model you’ve taken from prototype → production.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Product Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Senior .NET Developer will lead the creation of robust solutions using .NET Core, C#, and related technologies. This role demands advanced expertise in developing scalable applications, mentoring junior developers, and driving technological innovation within our software ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:


- Leading the design and development of complex, high-performance .NET applications, meeting business requirements.

- Mentoring junior and semi-senior developers, fostering technical excellence.

- Making key architectural decisions, contributing to long-term strategic planning of software projects.

- Overseeing code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and best practices.

- Evaluating and advocating for the adoption of new .NET technologies and practices.

- Providing technical insights and recommendations to project managers and other stakeholders.


Requirements:


- Experience: 5+ years with .NET

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles and clean code

- Code Quality: Extensive experience with code reviews and automated testing

- Testing Expertise: Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and maintaining high code coverage

- Decision Making: Demonstrated ability to make informed technical decisions

- Infrastructure: IT infrastructure knowledge

- Language: Advanced level of English



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior/Staff Backend Developer (Nest.JS - AWS - Mongo - Apollo GraphQL)
description:
Senior/Staff Backend Developer (Nest.JS - AWS - Mongo - Apollo GraphQL)


Required skills: Nest.JS, MongoDB, AWS, Apollo GraphQL.


Position Overview:

We're seeking a very experienced Senior/Staff Backend developer/ Architect to modernize and extend our ExpiWell research platform API using NestJS and Apollo GraphQL, AWS and MongoDB Atlas architecture. The main server will be serving a native IOS and and Android Application as well a modern unified React Native app.


Key Responsibilities

- Migrate legacy API endpoints from Express to NestJS v11 with full TypeScript typing.

- Build RESTful APIs, WebSocket gateways, and background job systems. -Improve out AWS infrastructure to a more modern VPS. AWS certification a huge plus. - Redesign our MongoDB architecture to better align with global customers. 

- Apollo GraphQL certificate training in Parts 1 to 4. (must complete)

- Implement authentication, payment processing, and real-time messaging features.

- Write comprehensive unit tests (Jest) and maintain >80% code coverage

- Design and document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.

- Implement AWS integrations (S3, SES) and third-party services (SendGrid, Stripe, Twilio)


Required Skills

Technical Stack

- Expert-level NestJS (v11+) with dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes

- Advanced TypeScript (v5.7+) with generics, decorators, and type safety patterns -Apollo GraphQL basic 1-4 certificate training, link above.

- MongoDB with Mongoose ODM and complex aggregations

- Testing: Jest, unit testing, E2E testing, test coverage strategies

- RESTful API design and versioning strategies

- WebSocket/Socket.IO for real-time features

- AWS Services: S3, SES, CloudWatch

- Git workflow with conventional commits and PR reviews


Nice to Have

- React / Next.js experience

- Redis for caching and distributed locking

- Stripe payment integration

- Twilio SMS/voice integration

- Puppeteer/headless browser automation

- Sentry/ Data Dog error monitoring

- Docker containerization

- Experience with research/survey platforms


What Makes You Great for This Role

- You understand modern backend architecture (microservices, event-driven, CQRS)

- You write clean, maintainable code that follows SOLID principles

- You're comfortable working with large codebases and legacy migration

- You proactively write tests and documentation

- You can debug complex issues across multiple services

- You stay current with JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem trends


Project Context

You'll be working on a research platform that powers mobile experience sampling studies. The API handles:

- Survey delivery and response collection

- Real-time participant messaging

- Payment/incentive distribution

- Media upload and transcription

- Geofencing and sensor triggers

- Anonymous survey participation

Development Environment

- Framework: NestJS v11 monorepo with shared libraries

- Code Quality: ESLint v9, Prettier, TypeScript

- Testing: Jest v30 with coverage reporting

- AI Tools: Claude Code CLI for development assistance

- Deployment: AWS infrastructure


How to Apply

Submit your application with:

1. Resume highlighting NestJS, GraphQL, MongoDB and TypeScript projects

2. GitHub and LinkedIn profile


What We Offer:

* Fully remote, flexible work setup

* Supportive, collaborative global team

* * Opportunities for long-term growth and increased responsibility

title: ALUME Institute Association (NGO) — Co-Founder BizDev Finance
description:
ALUME Institute Association (NGO) — Co-Founder & Chief Financial and Development Officer (CFDO)

Location: Remote (Brazil)

⏳ Commitment: 10-12h/week



About ALUME Institute

ALUME Institute is a Brazilian non-profit NGO based at Fazenda ALUME in Ilhéus, Bahia. We are dedicated to regenerating land and empowering communities through education, sustainability, health, and culture.

Our farm spans 42 hectares (100 acres) with seven natural springs and is located just 7 km from the Atlantic Ocean on Bahia’s Cacao Coast.


Half of the land remains preserved, while the other half—previously exploited—is being reforested and revitalized through agroforestry and sustainable land management.

Beyond restoration, our mission includes purchasing additional land for preservation , creating tribal co-living communities , and fostering spiritual and social growth .


Our work focuses on:

  • Education and training
  • Social impact and volunteering
  • Ecology, health, and community development
  • Fundraising and financial sustainability for impactful initiatives



Role Overview

We are seeking a Co-Founder & Chief Financial and Development Officer (CFDO) — a strategic leader who will bridge financial strategy and resource development to drive ALUME’s sustainable growth.

This role combines the responsibilities of a CFO (financial structure, governance, compliance) and a Business Development & Fundraising Lead (partnerships, CSR programs, grant strategy).

The ideal candidate will understand NGO business models , funding mechanisms , and how to align financial sustainability with mission impact .


Key Responsibilities Financial Strategy & Governance (CFO Role)

  • Develop and execute financial strategy, planning, and analysis
  • Oversee budgeting, reporting, cash flow , legal compliance, and audits
  • Manage banking relationships , financial forecasting, and risk control
  • Ensure transparency, accountability , and sustainable financial structure

Key Responsibilities Financial Strategy & Governance (CFO Role)

  • Develop and execute financial strategy, planning, and analysis
  • Oversee budgeting, reporting, cash flow , legal compliance, and audits
  • Manage banking relationships , financial forecasting, and risk control
  • Ensure transparency, accountability , and sustainable financial structure

title: Account Executive (B2B Lead Generation Company)
description:
About Upcision


We’re not an agency that talks about performance. We live it.


Upcision is a B2B lead generation company that gets paid only when clients get results. No retainers. No fluff. Every client spends real dollars tied to real performance.


We’re looking for a sharp, high-initiative Account Executive who thrives on closing measurable business, not just managing activity. You’ll start with an existing pool of leads and past prospects, but the real value comes from how you build momentum, re-engaging, sourcing new opportunities, and owning the full cycle from outreach to close.


What You’ll Do

  • Take full ownership of your pipeline, from first contact to signed deal, using CRM.
  • Start with a large base of warm and aged B2B leads, then expand it through targeted outreach and smart prospecting.
  • Re-engage old conversations, qualify new ones, and move decisively to close.
  • Track what converts, refine messaging, and feed insights back into the system.
  • Work directly with leadership to shape positioning, optimize process, and scale what works.


Who Thrives Here

You’ll do well here if you:


  • Speak fluent English and communicate naturally with U.S. business owners and marketing leaders.
  • Prefer autonomy over instruction. You organize your own day and keep pace without reminders.
  • See compensation as a function of output, not tenure.
  • Have experience selling B2B services or SaaS where results mattered more than time spent.
  • Keep your CRM tight, follow through consistently, and take personal ownership for every stage of your pipeline.

What We Offer


  • Competitive base (based on region) + aggressive commission with no cap.
  • Transparent performance tracking — you’ll always know where you stand.
  • Direct access to founder-level mentorship and growth visibility.
  • Freedom to test new angles, messaging, and channels; we value operators, not order-takers.
  • 100% remote, U.S.-time-zone-aligned team.

title: Scrum Master - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The role will be a key management and coordination point ensuring business and technical requirements are accurately captured, dependencies are met, and solutions are efficiently and effectively delivered and adopted across the enterprise. We support project teams and squads that deliver with excellence.


Key responsibilities:


- Guide teams in mastering Scrum practices for effective execution.

- Lead Scrum events, enhancing collaboration and transparency.

- Collaborate with Product Owners to refine backlog priorities.

- Remove obstacles to boost quality deliverables.

- Cultivate continuous improvement and best practices.

- Foster self-organization and positive teamwork.

- Ensure adherence to values and sustainable pace.

- Align with Scrum Masters and stakeholders for synergy.


Requirements:


- More than three years of experience as a Scrum Master.

- More than four years of experience in the IT industry.

- Master Jira and Confluence tools to drive efficiency.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

title: Gerente de Tesouraria, Finanças e Fiscal
description:
Sobre Nós


A Consulting Blue é uma consultoria líder, dedicada a ajudar empresas a alcançar a excelência operacional e estratégica. Trabalhamos com clientes de diversos setores, do varejo à tecnologia, para resolver desafios complexos e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável. Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma equipe de profissionais apaixonados, inovadores e orientados a resultados.


Descrição da Vaga


Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Tesouraria, Finanças e Fiscal para liderar nosso departamento financeiro. Se você é um profissional com visão estratégica, perfil analítico e vasta experiência em finanças corporativas e gestão tributária, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você impulsionar sua carreira em um ambiente dinâmico e focado em resultados.

Suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Liderar a gestão completa do fluxo de caixa , contas a pagar e receber , e o controle do endividamento.  
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento estratégico com bancos e instituições financeiras, incluindo a captação de recursos e o fechamento de operações de câmbio.  
  • Estruturar e executar o planejamento financeiro e orçamentário (Budget e Forecast).  
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade econômica de novos projetos e controlar custos e despesas para otimizar os resultados.  
  • Supervisionar toda a rotina fiscal, desde a apuração de impostos e entrega de obrigações acessórias até o desenvolvimento do planejamento tributário.  
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais que sirvam de base para a tomada de decisão da alta gestão.  
  • Garantir a conformidade com a legislação tributária vigente e atender a fiscalizações.  
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe financeira e fiscal.  

O que buscamos em você:

  • Experiência Essencial:
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Contabilidade e Normas Contábeis (CPC/IFRS) , Legislação Fiscal e Matemática Financeira.  
  • Vivência prática em gestão de fluxo de caixa , planejamento tributário , análise de demonstrativos financeiros e elaboração de orçamentos.  
  • Domínio de Sistemas de Gestão (ERP) , planilhas eletrônicas e ferramentas de BI.  
  • Experiência com o mercado financeiro e de capitais , incluindo operações de crédito e financiamento. 

  • Perfil Desejado:
  • Um profissional com perfil analítico , organizado e com extrema atenção aos detalhes.  
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz.  
  • Atitude proativa na busca por eficiência , com forte senso de urgência e foco em resultados.  
  • Postura ética, resiliente e prudente.  
  • Visão sistêmica para entender o impacto financeiro nas diversas áreas da empresa.  


Local do trabalho: Porto Alegre/RS



Se você se identifica com os requisitos e busca um desafio para impulsionar a sua carreira, envie seu currículo para o email:

title: Director, Business Value Consulting
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Remote: Sao Paulo, Brazil
Your Career
In this Director Business Value Consulting role, you will build value-based business-cases for cybersecurity investment, by leading cross-functional teams composed of customer-executives, sales team, solution consultants, and other functional groups. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
Your Impact
  • Support the sales process by providing expertise in value-based selling
  • Contribute to team thought leadership by synthesizing experiences into reusable content and frameworks
  • Develop and deliver value-focused training and workshops for customers
  • Elevate the value function internally, influencing field sales strategies for key accounts
  • Lead cross-functional, multi-department engagement teams with our partners, customers, and senior Palo Alto Networks experts from sales, pre-sales, consulting, and solution architecture—working to shape and drive cybersecurity and digital transformation capabilities
  • Coach team members by leveraging consulting expertise to identify C-level strategic issues, assess process capabilities, and develop business cases for IT and security transformation
  • Create industry-specific and Palo Alto Networks solution-based value selling tools, programs, and initiatives for sales, alliances, and marketing teams
  • Support value-selling training initiatives across the sales ecosystem
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 12+ years of experience, preferably with a top management consulting firm or technology company, focusing on business transformation
  • Expertise in building business cases with in-depth financial analysis and ROI/TCO modeling
  • Strong executive presence and situational awareness, with a proven track record of influencing C-suite leaders to drive key business decisions
  • Proven ability to foster accountability and build consensus across teams and customers, driving operational excellence and ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, applying consulting frameworks and methodologies, while offering creative solutions to drive executive decisions
  • Ability to quickly adapt and contribute to projects across various industries, including IT and OT challenges in cybersecurity, business applications, and systems
  • Experience in Cyber Risk Assessment, Cybersecurity, and Cloud Sales & Strategy are highly desirable
  • MBA preferred
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English.
  • Palo Alto Networks Cybersecurity Apprentice and Cybersecurity Practitioner certifications certifications are strongly encouraged
Additional Information
The Team
Business Value Consulting is a strategic, consultative team that engages with Fortune 1000 and public sector customers to build and deliver strategic business justification as their cybersecurity partner. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
The Worldwide Shared Services org is dedicated to empowering Palo Alto Networks’ go-to-market teams through innovative solutions and strategic guidance to drive superior outcomes. We strive to equip our teams with the expertise and resources needed to make a meaningful and lasting impact with the customers we serve while achieving sales excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, creating a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing to drive collective growth and success.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial

  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Operar e manter em bom estado os sistemas de mísseis antitanque
  • Executar tarefas táticas com a unidade, incluindo vários tipos de manobras e disposição técnica

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Latam Training Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a LATAM Training Supervisor!


Are you a proactive individual with a talent for building relationships and achieving results? We are seeking a dynamic Training Supervisor to lead the development and implementation of high-quality training programs for our customers, distributors, and partners. You will work closely with our Service Manager to transform training needs into successes, executing innovative training strategies and ensuring exceptional training experiences.


The Big Picture (Purpose):


The Training Supervisor will be instrumental in developing and executing high-quality training programs tailored for our customers, distributors, and partners. This role is dedicated to enhancing the knowledge and skills of stakeholders, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary expertise to use, promote, and support Alliance Laundry products effectively. The Training Supervisor will collaborate with various departments to identify key training needs, create engaging educational content, and deliver impactful training sessions using a variety of mediums. By fostering strong relationships and providing exceptional training experiences, the Training Supervisor will help strengthen brand loyalty, improve partner performance, and drive the overall success of Alliance Laundry in the marketplace.


What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):


  • Identify training needs by analyzing performance evaluations and gathering feedback from customers.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive technical training programs that align with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangements, and procurement of necessary materials.
  • Manage the training budget effectively to optimize resource allocation and utilization.
  • Deliver training sessions through various formats, including in-person workshops, webinars, and lectures.
  • Select and oversee external instructors or facilitators as needed to ensure high-quality training delivery.
  • Develop and utilize evaluation tools, such as quizzes and surveys, to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
  • Gather and analyze participant feedback to continuously refine and improve training content and delivery.
  • Maintain detailed records of training activities, including participant engagement and outcomes.
  • Prepare regular reports on training progress and its impact on partner and stakeholder performance.
  • Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of training initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to discuss the development and deployment of technicians throughout Brazil and the Latin American region.
  • Actively recruit new technicians to address coverage gaps in underserved areas.
  • Manage resources and maintain relationships with ABRALAV to support training initiatives.
  • Work closely with the North American Training Group to ensure alignment and leverage shared resources and strategies.
  • Collaborate with the LATAM marketing team to provide technical validation, ensuring the accuracy of marketing materials.


What you need to bring to the table (Experience):


Education & Experience:


  • Knowledge of Chemistry, mechanics, electrical, electronics and pneumatics.
  • Experience with deepwater oil extraction equipment, corrosion protection systems, programming and configuration of professional laundry equipment software, general maintenance and application of training for professional laundry maintenance technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).



Skills and Abilities:


  • Service-oriented: understands customer issues and is willing to help.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanics, electronics, and electrical systems.
  • Ability to work with others, assertive and diplomatic.
  • Must be able to travel up to 70% of the time.



Standard and Physical Requirements:


  • Position may involve standing for long periods, manual dexterity, stooping, bending.
  • Position requires the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. rarely. For greater weight items assistive devices will be provided.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear;
    and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting;
    close vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean Motor Vehicle Record.


Alliance Team Members Demonstrate DRIVE:

  • Dedicated: Follows through on commitments. Strong say/do.
  • Respectful: Acts with integrity and values diverse perspective.
  • Innovative: Always looking for a better way;
    leads change.
  • Versatile: Adapts quickly to changing circumstances. Demonstrates agility.
  • Engaged: Acts like an owner. Wants to create and grow a business which is tightly aligned with market needs.

title: Head Of Product Design (Ui/Ux, Ai-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Network Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Network Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must have:

- Engineer or Technologist of systems or telecommunications, in computer science or related, with experience in management of local area networks (wired/wireless) for more 2000 virtual /physical devices and extended datacenter supporting critical business environments.

- Creation/Editing medium and high critical configuration scripts for new environments/ troubleshooting/ remediation scenario.

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Experience for configuration, troubleshooting, testing, IMAC for access/border/core network for Cisco/HP Family.

- This Family comprises small/medium switches L2/L3, small/medium/large Router L3-L7 for access/edge/core, WLAN Cisco/HP

- This CoE wants coverage firewalls Palo Alto, SASE - apply policies/rules/group member/individual

- Identification, testing and built cabling CAT5-9, fiberoptics MM/SM

- Testing for data communication radio & mobile access

- Knowledge for NSX /Virtualization network

- Active Directory/ Radius/802.1x/ MFA authentication.

- Palo Alto Firewall / Windows Jump Server configuration.

- Palo Alto VPN.

- Panorama and Cortex Management for large number of devices.

- Prepare, validate and conduct change Management process.

- Capacity/Performance analysis (CPU, Mem, throughput ports).

- Good Communication skills.

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

.

Good to have:

- Cisco CCNA Certification desirable.

- Knowledge Fortinet/Huawei for network (LAN/WLAN) and security devices.

- Firewalls Paloalto and network security administration.

- Palo Alto Panorama and large number of firewall visibility and administration.

- Setup, configuration, integration, design, zero trust. Rules optimization, IP Policy and documentation

- Hardening, standard setup to prod preparation, capacity planning, high availability and failover

- Virtual and appliances devices, cloud and on prem, backup & Restore.

- VPN IPsec and Client to site implementation

- Integration with other security team members from threat intel, SOC

- Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;

- Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use

- Identify and immediately report to the Level 2 Service Supervisor critical problems that have significant impacts on the technological environment of Customer, exceptional situations and other situations beyond its control or jurisdiction.

- Perform analysis of the hardware requirements for software installation.

- Test functionalities of new equipment, components or peripherals, and prepare configuration and user guides or manuals;

- Act in the execution of activities of the asset management process in Customer locations where there are no asset technicians allocated, at times when the Asset Management service is not available or whenever required by supervision.

- Understand cybersecurity attacks, mitigation methods.

Key responsibilities:

The network Associate is responsible for the LAN, WAN, WLAN or SDWAN Network. On LANs, WANs, WLANs, SDWANs, it is responsible for addressing, switches, routers, WiFi related devices, AD, DNS, NPM, Firewalls, CDN's, Balancers, NFV. In the WAN he is responsible for private networks and the Internet, and assists in the adoption of monitoring and data collection tools in the network. Supports carrier trunking with the local network, and participate on complex Network Setups.

- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Controle Agrícola JR para atuar no nosso time do COA.

Realizar solicitação, abertura e manutenção de OS

Efetuar analise e encerramento das OS

Gerir os apontamentos relacionados a OS

Analisar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (lead time e divergências de OS)

Apoiar nas demais atividades do Controle agrícola


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino médio completo (desejável técnico ou superior cursando em áreas como Administração, Agronegócio, Engenharia Agronômica ou correlatas).

Conhecimento em gestão de cadastros, controle de áreas agrícolas OS e análise de dados operacionais.

Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Perfil proativo, com atenção aos detalhes e foco em resultados.

Desejável experiência anterior em funções administrativas no setor agrícola ou sucroalcooleiro.


Qual localidade?

Guaíra/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

description:
Are you a proactive technical support professional with a passion for medical aesthetic technology?


Quartier Latin is a rapidly expanding importer and distributor of cutting-edge medical aesthetic equipment in Brazil, and we are in an exciting phase of growth! Following the consolidated success of our 2D/3D imaging camera and its analysis software, we have expanded our portfolio with the addition of an advanced cryolipolysis device.

This is a crucial position responsible for providing specialized technical assistance, training, and maintenance for both our advanced 2D/3D analysis systems and our new cryolipolysis devices. You will be a key player in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our customers across Brazil and Latin America.

  • Collaborate with the Supply Chain department for repair estimates and warranty management.
  • Interface with Marketing, Sales, Production, and R&D teams to provide valuable customer feedback and contribute to continuous product improvement.
  • Develop and deliver product training for customers and distributors.
  • Create and update technical documentation (user manuals, FAQs, troubleshooting guides).
  • Report bugs and critical field information to the Research and Development department.


What We're Looking For:


Essential Experience:

  • Technical Degree completed (technical courses/degrees in Electronics, Mechatronics, IT, Automation, or related fields are a plus).
